body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its 30-inch wide monitor ‘W3000H’ during KES 2007, which features a Windows Vista Premium certified. Adopting four USB ports and an adjustable stand, it supports 3000:1 contrast ratio, 370cd/m² brightness, 5ms response speed and 178-degree viewing angle.
